name: 04_check_the_path
origin: Claude's own mistake (2026-10-05): a DeepSeek task asked for tool_choice on a paid path that refuses it

memories.title: Check the required path supports what the task asks
memories.body: Before delegating, confirm the route a task must use (e.g. the paid configured client) supports every requested control. The DeepSeek debrief asked for tool_choice on a path that refuses it; cost one implementer increment.

steps.note: Six weeks later, planning a new delegation still surfaces the lesson.
